title: EXP-093 - Hello World Part 6 Sections 1-4 Discovery: FX_Orders Script Language, Form Script Editor, Event Handlers and Data Change Fields (Read-Only), with an Unsaved Count Change at Runtime
objective: Prepare hello-world-pt6.md Sections 1-4 (00:27-04:16), adapted to FX_ names and User scope, by read-only discovery on the FX_Orders Form. In the Web Designer record Behavior > Script Language, open the form script editor once through its Edit Form Script entry point to record the editor and its current content, and leave it with Cancel without any change; record the Details > Event Handlers grid; and record the Events group (Data Change and any other event fields) of FX_ItemCombobox, FX_CountEdit, FX_DerOrderTotalEdit, FX_ItemGridCol, FX_CountGridCol and FX_DerOrderTotalGridCol. No Designer change and no Designer Save. Then in the Web Client, after one runtime close/reopen and one blank-criteria query, on order 1: Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00, change Count to 3 once (typed, Tab once) and record Order Total before any Save (the tutorial says the derived total changes only after Save). Never save: discard by closing and answering No, reopen and verify both orders. Findings are observed only and prepare EXP-094, which will use operator-supplied script code.

Designer gate (read-only): the Designer is in User scope and clean on FX_Orders (open it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry if needed); record the Form-level Properties Behavior group, including Script Language and the control beside it that leads to Edit Form Script (exact labels and icons).

Form script editor (read-only): open the form script editor once through its Edit Form Script entry point. Record the dialog title, its buttons and controls, the language shown and the full current content verbatim (expected a placeholder such as 'methods go here'; record whatever is shown), with a screenshot. Never click into or type in the editor. Leave it once with Cancel; if there is no Cancel, use its close control; if any prompt about saving appears, answer No once and record its exact text. Afterwards verify the Designer is still clean (Save disabled).

Event handlers (read-only): open Details > Event Handlers once and record every row shown (event name, sequence, response type, disabled flag and summary), with a screenshot; do not open any row's parameters and do not use New. Record whether a custom event name list is visible anywhere without opening a dialog.

Component events (read-only): for each of FX_ItemCombobox, FX_CountEdit, FX_DerOrderTotalEdit, FX_ItemGridCol, FX_CountGridCol and FX_DerOrderTotalGridCol, select it in the Details > Components grid (or the Properties component selector) and record its Binding and the full Events group of its Properties panel (Data Change and every other event field, with values), expanding the group by a view click if collapsed; screenshot FX_CountEdit and FX_CountGridCol. Never open an event field's drop-down or editor. If a named component does not exist, record it and continue with the others.

Runtime baseline (read-only): in the Web Client, if FX_Orders is open close it once (clean); open it once through Form > Open > Select Form, record the mode, switch to Filter in Place if needed, leave every criterion blank and press F4 once; verify order 1: Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00 and order 2: Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Address 2 Factory Street, Item eggs, Item Description cage free, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99 (move between orders only by clicking their row-number cells).

Runtime Count check: on order 1 click the detail-view Count field once, select its whole content, type 3 once, press Tab once, and record without any Save the Count, Cost, Order Total and the order 1 grid row values that are visible, with a screenshot. Expected by the tutorial: Order Total stays 90.00 before Save; record whatever is shown as observed only.

Discard: close the runtime FX_Orders Form once; answer No once to the prompt to save changes and record its exact text; if any other prompt appears answer No once and record its exact text; if no save prompt appears, record it and stop blocked for the coordinator without further action. Then reopen FX_Orders once through Form > Open > Select Form (blank criteria, F4 once; row-number cells only) and verify order 1: Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00 and order 2: Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Address 2 Factory Street, Item eggs, Item Description cage free, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99 unchanged.
Close the runtime FX_Orders Form once at the end (clean).

Capture screenshots of the Designer gate (Behavior group with Script Language), the script editor before leaving it, the Designer after leaving it, the Event Handlers grid, the FX_CountEdit and FX_CountGridCol Events groups, the runtime baseline, the order 1 values after the Count change, the save prompt before answering, and the reopened orders.
